raw:
@a1 assumed
  relation "come on"
  role subject "child benefit"
  role object "the first Tuesday of the month"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@a2 assumed
  relation "change"
  role subject "the timing of child benefit"
  polarity negated
  basis implicature
  valid from "last year"

@q query
  where match
    relation "come on"
    role subject "child benefit in Ireland"
    role object "the first Tuesday of the month"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "change"
    role subject "the timing of child benefit"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  at "since last year"
